standard.summary: 训练前向中对视觉 token 做 ToMe（Token Merging）合并，减少 attention 参与的 token 数量以降低计算开销。实验性，默认关闭。
standard.effect: 开启后按 tome_ratio 在每次前向合并相似 token；关闭时不构建任何 seam，前向与基线逐位一致。不支持的模型族会告警并保持关闭（reason=tome_unsupported_family）。
standard.whenToUse: 高分辨率训练中 attention 计算成为速度瓶颈、且可以接受轻微质量损失换吞吐的场景。
standard.avoidWhen: 对细节保真要求高的训练（合并 token 本质是有损压缩）；模型族不在支持列表时开了也不生效；与其它改变 token 序列的功能（如 token downsampling）叠加时行为难预期。

standard_en.summary: Merges visual tokens with ToMe (Token Merging) in the training forward pass, cutting the number of tokens that take part in attention and so the computational cost. Experimental, off by default.
standard_en.effect: Once enabled, similar tokens are merged on every forward pass according to tome_ratio; when off, no seam is built at all and the forward pass is bit-identical to the baseline. An unsupported model family warns and stays off (reason=tome_unsupported_family).
standard_en.whenToUse: When attention computation is the speed bottleneck in high-resolution training and you can accept a small quality loss in exchange for throughput.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Training that demands high detail fidelity (merging tokens is lossy compression by nature); enabling it does nothing when the model family is not on the supported list; the behaviour is hard to predict when stacked with other features that change the token sequence (token downsampling, say).

advanced.principle: ToMe（Bolya et al.）基于相邻 token 的相似度做双向匹配合并，attention 在缩短后的序列上计算，随后再展开。计算量随合并比例近似线性下降，而扩散模型的特征冗余使小比例合并的质量损失可控。
advanced.intervention: training_loop.py:_get_tome_seam 按模型族校验后调用 build_tome_seam(enabled=True, ratio=tome_ratio)；tome_runtime.py 用 ContextVar 在每次模型前向的作用域内发布 seam，前向结束自动复位；被运行时阻断时逐名告警并按未合并执行。
advanced.expectedImpact: attention 阶段耗时随 ratio 下降；质量随 ratio 上升逐渐受损，建议从 0.3~0.5 起测。
advanced.tradeoffs: 训练与推理的 token 拓扑不一致可能引入轻微分布偏移；parity 红线保证默认关闭时零影响。
advanced.codePath: training_loop.py:_get_tome_seam；tome_runtime.py:build_tome_seam（默认关不构建 seam，前向位级一致）

advanced_en.principle: ToMe (Bolya et al.) merges tokens by bidirectional matching on neighboring-token similarity; attention runs on the shortened sequence, which is then expanded back. Compute falls roughly linearly with the merge ratio, and diffusion models' feature redundancy keeps the quality loss of small-ratio merging manageable.
advanced_en.intervention: training_loop.py:_get_tome_seam calls build_tome_seam(enabled=True, ratio=tome_ratio) after per-model-family validation; tome_runtime.py publishes the seam via a ContextVar scoped to each model forward and resets it automatically when the forward ends; when blocked by the runtime it warns by name and executes unmerged.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Attention-stage time falls with ratio; quality degrades gradually as ratio rises — start testing from 0.3~0.5.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The token-topology mismatch between training and inference may introduce slight distribution shift; the parity red line guarantees zero impact when off by default.
advanced_en.codePath: training_loop.py:_get_tome_seam; tome_runtime.py:build_tome_seam (off by default builds no seam, forward is bitwise identical)
